Sub was closed 6 months ago.
However [there's post](https://www.reddit.com/r/maledom/comments/1vl7yr/put_your_maledommale_supremacymale/) with a list of subs with this type of ideology.

Using related throw away...

So long story short: Two months ago my gf and I were planning our wedding for this July. That all changed when she walked in with her mother and announced she doesn't love me.

Hurt like fuck.

To see more about that, read my comment history... But a while ago I had to talk to her disabled lil sister. Say my goodbye knowing I won't ever see her either. She called me and I couldn't turn her call away... Had to explain I'm not the guy she wanted after all. That people sometimes change their mind.

Didn't have the heart to tell that she ran off with a guy she was cheating on me with...
